summary: The OpenTelemetry interceptor plugin automatically adds trace_id and span_id to custom metrics, causing unbounded cardinality issues. This was fixed in version 1.18.1.
userImpact: Users reporting custom metrics with OpenTelemetry tracing enabled experience unbounded metric cardinality, potentially causing performance degradation and excessive storage consumption.
rootCause: The OpenTelemetry interceptor was automatically appending trace_id and span_id attributes to custom metrics, creating unbounded cardinality since these are unique per trace.
proposedFix: Remove or prevent automatic addition of trace_id/span_id to custom metrics in the OpenTelemetry interceptor.
resolutionDetails: Fixed in version 1.18.1 and published to NPM.
keyQuote: trace_id/span_id are added to custom metrics which leads to unbounded cardinality
